lines.text: How do you say the time?
Many learners say: I wake up at 6 hour.
Better: I wake up at 6 o'clock.
7 o'clock! I wake up at 7 o'clock.

native.tip: Chữ “giờ” trong “6 giờ” không phải “hour.” Tiếng Anh nói “6 o'clock.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “I wake up at 6 hour.” không? 😅 Khi nói giờ tròn, hãy dùng “o'clock”: “I wake up at 6 o'clock.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.

en.caption: Do you often say this? “I wake up at 6 hour.” For a full hour, use “o'clock”: “I wake up at 6 o'clock.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
